name: Nogawa Shigeaki
source:
The protagonist of this work.
He is a 37-year-old editor for the occult magazine "Paranormal Idola". His hobby is his work and his only friend is cigarettes. He's also a bit of an insomniac.
He is a cynical person, always grumbling, who can't take on a single task at the editorial department without first voicing his complaint about it. But once he gets going, his enthusiasm takes over and he has a great time.
He has a neutral view of the occult, until he gets involved with the ghost story of "The House with the Red Roof", and his world is turned upside down.

[Translated from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/shikai/#character]official website[/url]]
